Class Tribu

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.model.player.Tribu
public class Tribu extends Object
Represents a player's tribe — the central aggregate that tracks all resources, characters, buildings, inventions, and passive effects accumulated during the game.

Resource fields (food, prestige points, shaman stars, discounts) are accumulated additively throughout the game. Building effects and character effects are registered via the observer pattern and fire automatically when the relevant game events occur.

    • insertCharacter

      public EffectOutcome insertCharacter(String characterID, Player owner)
      Adds a character card to this tribe and applies its immediate effect. Also notifies all registered TribuObservers of the insertion.
      Parameters:
      characterID - the ID of the character card to insert (must exist in GameRegistry)
      owner - the player who owns this tribe
      Returns:
      an EffectOutcome aggregating all resource deltas produced by the insertion

    • insertBuilding

      public EffectOutcome insertBuilding(String buildingID, Player owner, Game game)
      Adds a building card to this tribe, credits its base prestige points, and registers its active BuildingEffect with the appropriate game-level observers.
      Parameters:
      buildingID - the ID of the building card to insert (must exist in GameRegistry)
      owner - the player who owns this tribe
      game - the current Game instance, used to attach phase/event observers
      Returns:
      an EffectOutcome containing the prestige-point delta for the building's base PP
      Throws:
      it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.model.exceptions.CardNotFoundException - if the building ID does not exist in the registry

    • setImmuneToShamanicPenalty

      public void setImmuneToShamanicPenalty(boolean status)
      Sets or clears immunity to the Shamanic Ritual penalty. When immune, this tribe does not lose prestige points for having the fewest shaman stars.
      Parameters:
      status - true to grant immunity, false to remove it
